Actions.description:
What happens to a claim that does not stand, by the task's context (an output kind or a document kind);
`default` for any other. A context the contract lists as immutable is never rewritten.

replace_with.description: The caveat a blocked passage gives way to, in a mutable output.
replace_with.title: Replace With

Actions.title: Actions

AgentStateScope.description:
What one working state belongs to. The id travels in the body, never in a URL: a conversation id may
look like a phone number.
AgentStateScope.title: AgentStateScope

AgentStateWrite.description:
A write of an agent's working state, by its code and never by a model: `cas` replaces the whole state
at `if_version` (0 when it must not exist yet); `merge_by_key` replaces each top-level field it names and
removes a field written as exactly `{"$delete": true}`.
AgentStateWrite.title: AgentStateWrite

coverage.description: Counted apart: law and fact never add up.
coverage.title: Coverage

Attribute.description:
What the person is: a size, a preferred network, a diet. Said here; the lifecycle's outcomes (bought,
kept, returned for size) derive the rest on the server, never an agent.
Attribute.title: Attribute

AttributionReport.description: Value by method and band, deterministic and probable apart; weights are never summed as money.
AttributionReport.title: AttributionReport

Change.description: One entry of the change log the bisection walks.
Change.title: Change

CheckRequest.description:
What an agent is about to do. Without a subject there is no budget, suppression or owner to consult:
such a check only asks about the effect key.

destination_hash.description: The token's `rcpt`, computed by a caller that holds the gateway's key, when the destination is not the subject's handle.
destination_hash.title: Destination Hash

effect_key.description: The business fact's key; reserved atomically when nothing holds it.
effect_key.title: Effect Key

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

CheckResult.description:
The coordination decision. `reasons` are codes (the coordination spec, 4); `holder` is who to hand
off to with `handoff_to`. `contact_token` comes only with an allowed outbound contact of a purpose that
needs one.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

ClaimContractSummary.description:
The contract as the SDK keeps it: everything but the negative corpus's phrases, which only the CI's
`niadra contract test` reads, from the company's own copy.
ClaimContractSummary.title: ClaimContractSummary

ClaimEvidence.description: What the turn record must hold for a claim of the category to stand: exactly one kind.

tool.description: A call of this tool in the turn.
tool.title: Tool

ClaimEvidence.title: ClaimEvidence

ClaimEvidenceRef.description: Where a claim's evidence is in the turn record: a call's field, an object's field, or a document.

anchor.description: The blob that keeps the quoted text.
anchor.title: Anchor

ClaimEvidenceRef.title: ClaimEvidenceRef

ClaimRecord.description: One claim the SDK found in an output, as the turn record carries it: kinds, spans and verdicts.

action.description: What was done, which the contract's configured action decides: `rewrite_if_unequivocal` is `rewrite` when the rewrite is unequivocal and `warn` otherwise, `discard_anchor_and_count` is `discard_anchor`, and a claim that stands (`matched`, `quoted_found`, `anchored`) is `none`.
action.title: Action

span.description: Code point offsets of the claim in the output, end exclusive.
span.title: Span

ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord

ClaimRequest.description:
A declared claim, held by `holder`. `level` defaults to the space's least restrictive level; a
declaration is refused (409 `lease_held`) while another holder's claim is at least as restrictive, and the
same holder renews its own. `lease_s` is capped by the space's longest declared lease.
ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest

ClaimValue.description:
A number the parser read, normalized: an amount, or a range from `min` to `max`, with its unit (the
currency code of money, `%`, a time unit, a unit of measure or of dose), or a date, or a range of
dates.
ClaimValue.title: ClaimValue

ClaimVia.description:
The three ways in: a declaration through the API, an observation mapped from a webhook, an observation
the company's worker read and sent.
ClaimVia.title: ClaimVia

CompanyRule.description:
A rule of the company delivered in the block, with where it lives and its rank in the order the company
declared: the block never ranks two origins by itself.
CompanyRule.title: CompanyRule

Conflict.description:
Two entries that cannot both hold, and the one that won: the current utterance over what was stated
before, and a stated entry over an inferred one. Between two company rules, it is also a data issue.
Conflict.title: Conflict

ConstraintsBlock.description: What one subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

ask.description: Questions the agent should ask, as `for_whom`, before assuming.
ask.title: Ask

relaxation_order.description: What gives way first when a search finds nothing: `soft`, ids.
relaxation_order.title: Relaxation Order

version.description: A digest of the block, which the turn record cites.
version.title: Version

ConstraintsBlock.title: ConstraintsBlock

ContactKey.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037). A `retiring` key still verifies and signs nothing new.
ContactKey.title: ContactKey

ContactKeys.description: A space's public keys a gateway checks a contact token with, offline.
ContactKeys.title: ContactKeys

ContactMadeDetail.description:
`jti` is the contact token's; `unchecked` says the contact left without a decision, because the
purpose fails open and none came in time.
ContactMadeDetail.title: ContactMadeDetail

ContentMarker.description: A content field whose text Niadra does not hold (`pointer`, `hash_only`), or holds under scan.

pointer.description: Where the SDK reads the text inside the company's boundary.
pointer.title: Pointer

ContentMarker.title: ContentMarker

Detect.description:
How a category finds its claims in the text, without a model: numbers of these classes, the words
around them that give their role, terms of the trade, named patterns, or sections of a document.

roles.description: The words that give a number its role, synonyms and every language in one list.
roles.title: Roles

terms.description: With `classes`, a number counts only in a sentence that holds one of them; alone, the term is the claim.
terms.title: Terms

Detect.title: Detect

Effect.description:
`effect_id` is the key's keyed hash: it names the effect in paths, where the key itself, which may
carry a conversation id, never goes.
Effect.title: Effect

EffectDetail.description: How the attempt the caller holds ended.
EffectDetail.title: EffectDetail

EffectStatus.description: `none` means nothing held the key and this check reserved it: the caller acts and then declares.
EffectStatus.title: EffectStatus

exposure_id.description: Absent for an item of no list.
exposure_id.title: Exposure Id

Feature.description:
The agent features a space turns on: everything is off until the space's `features`
document lists it, and `GET /v1/sdk/profile` announces what is on.
Feature.title: Feature

FieldState.description:
One field as a read serves it: the value with its logical value, stamps, source and observer, and the
freshness computed now against the type's current rule.

known_at.description: When Niadra first knew it; never moves.
known_at.title: Known At

masked.description: The reader's access masks the value: `v` is absent.
masked.title: Masked

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value.
observed_at.title: Observed At

FieldState.title: FieldState

Handle.description: An identifier of a subject in some channel or system: a phone, an e-mail, a CRM id.

scope.description: Namespace for scoped identifiers: the WhatsApp Business account for `wa_bsuid`, the system for `system_id`, the country for `gov_id_hmac`.
scope.title: Scope

subject_kind.description: Defaults to `person`, except for organization-only handle types.

Handle.title: Handle

HandoffContext.description: The compiled `handoff` view, at the receiving side's policy and verification level.
HandoffContext.title: HandoffContext

HandoffPackage.description: What a handoff carries to whoever receives it (the coordination spec, 7).
HandoffPackage.title: HandoffPackage

HardConstraint.description: Only what the person said: an inference is never hard.
HardConstraint.title: HardConstraint

InternalText.description:
Fingerprints of the company's own prompt: hashes of every `n` words, computed by the SDK, never the
prompt itself. An output that repeats one gives way to `redact`.

shingle_hashes_ref.description: The prompt version the hashes were computed from.
shingle_hashes_ref.title: Shingle Hashes Ref

InternalText.title: InternalText

LeaseDetail.description:
An owner lease or a case, held by the declaring agent. `level` defaults to the space's least
restrictive level.
LeaseDetail.title: LeaseDetail

Natures.description:
How a number is handled by where it came from: computed (a value with provenance in the turn, by rule
or observed) is checked against it; quoted (inside quotation marks) is checked only for being in a source,
as written, even when it is false; said by the model (no origin) takes this action, or the category's.
Natures.title: Natures

Notification.description: A webhook's body, for who pulls instead of receiving it: the same body, in `change_seq` order.
Notification.title: Notification

version.description: The source's version of the object. A field moves only when this is greater than the version that last wrote it; a source never reuses a version for other content.
version.title: Version

ObjectPushResponse.description:
How many items of the request each decision took, against the hot layer, with no database statement.

A shared object's item is `applied` when at least one of its fields moved forward: reads serve it at once,
and the consolidator writes it within a second with the same per-field rule, so the stored object never
disagrees with the answer. `stale_version`: every field was already written by this version or a greater
one, as a retried request finds. `out_of_set`: the object is not in the working set, and nothing is kept.
A subject's object is `recorded`: accepted as a system event about it, in the request's one statement,
and its fields move by the same rule when the event is applied.
ObjectPushResponse.title: ObjectPushResponse

ObjectRead.description:
One object as a state read serves it: fields with four logical values and their stamps, computed
values, lifecycle, timers and readings, and what may not be claimed with data this old. A read never
refuses; a `decide` read of a type that asks for it carries `refusal` beside the values, for the company's
tool.

blocked.description: What the fields whose value is not known block, as the type declares it (`unobserved_blocks`): each activity (`model_read`, `derive`, `claim`, or a task of the company such as `decide:close`) with the fields that block it. Nothing else is blocked.
blocked.title: Blocked

expired_by.description: The inputs whose change expired it.
expired_by.title: Expired By

withheld.description: Fields left out for this reader, and why.
withheld.title: Withheld

ObjectRead.title: ObjectRead

ObjectRef.description: A business object in a system of record, e.g. `invoice` / `erp` / `0823`.
ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef

ObjectSnapshotRequest.description: Reconciliation from an NDJSON file uploaded through the file path that exists (`/v1/ingest`).
ObjectSnapshotRequest.title: ObjectSnapshotRequest

OutcomeRequest.description: How the receiving side reports back: one of `vocabulary`, by `expected_by`.
OutcomeRequest.title: OutcomeRequest

state.description: A canonical state of the type, or `expired_without_outcome`.
state.title: State

Owner.description:
Who holds the subject or the object now: the most restrictive valid claim, where it came from and
until when. `epoch` fences a release.
Owner.title: Owner

Preference.description: What the person wants or refuses, said or captured from a tool's arguments; only these become hard.

category.description: Holds only in this category of the type.
category.title: Category

Preference.title: Preference

Presented.description:
A list delivered to the person: the exposure. Its canonical moment is `delivered_at`, when the
interface bridge handed the list to the client, never when a tool returned it or the model named it.

method.description: `bridge` from the interface bridge, `otel` from a `niadra.exposure` span, `tool_result` inferred from what a tool returned: labeled, because it counts more than was shown.
method.title: Method

page.description: "See more" is the same list with `page + 1`.
page.title: Page

visible_k.description: How many of the first items were visible on delivery.
visible_k.title: Visible K

Presented.title: Presented

pos.description: 1-based position in the whole list, across pages.
pos.title: Pos

shown.description: The values the item showed, for the fields its type tracks or lets be claimed; what `changes_since_seen` later compares against.
shown.title: Shown

team.description: Which of two interleaved lists contributed the item.
team.title: Team

PreviousValue.description: A field's value before its latest change, kept for the fields that declare `track_changes`.
PreviousValue.title: PreviousValue

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` comes from the versioned error catalog.
Problem.title: Problem

PromoteRequest.description:
Moves turns from the short tier (every turn, 7 days) to the kept one, by conversation or by id, with
the reason: the complaint arrives days after the turn.
PromoteRequest.title: PromoteRequest

not_found.description: Turns no longer in the short tier, or never recorded.
not_found.title: Not Found

Provenance.description:
Where pushed values come from: only a `live` source sustains a claim, and the age of every value counts
from `source_observed_at`.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ReadingResult.description:
A named reading's value, as niadra-expr computes it: the logical value, and the kind and value when
known (dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, times in UTC, durations in milliseconds).
ReadingResult.title: ReadingResult

ReleaseDetail.description: The claim a case closes, with the epoch it got when it was accepted.
ReleaseDetail.title: ReleaseDetail

Rendered.description: The block for one tool, through its bindings (`constraints.v0`, rendering).

args.description: Argument values that carry hard constraints and attributes.
args.title: Args

post_filter.description: Residual ids the SDK filters from the results of an overfetch.
post_filter.title: Post Filter

residual.description: Ids no argument of the tool can express.
residual.title: Residual

Rendered.title: Rendered

ReplayCase.description:
What the SDK's replay runner needs to run the turn again inside the customer's boundary: the frame,
pointers and hashes, pins, the pack and view of the time, the masked history up to the turn and the
suggested assertions. A pin that does not match stops the case with `pin_mismatch`.
ReplayCase.title: ReplayCase

ReviewRequestCreate.description: A request to review an automated decision (LGPD, art. 20), sent to the controller's DPO.
ReviewRequestCreate.title: ReviewRequestCreate

ScenarioFromReport.description: A bug report becomes a scenario: its turns are promoted and assertions suggested by rule.
ScenarioFromReport.title: ScenarioFromReport

ScenarioRunCreate.description: The customer's CI reports N executions of the scenarios; the statistics stay with Niadra.
ScenarioRunCreate.title: ScenarioRunCreate

SdkProfile.description:
What the SDK keeps in its local cache: the features on, the source's tool bindings, the summarized
type registry, the claim contract and turn recording.
SdkProfile.title: SdkProfile

Seen.description: A ping of the list component: how far the person saw.
Seen.title: Seen

StateRef.description: An object of the type registry: a subject's or a shared one, whose key may name a variant.
StateRef.title: StateRef

StateView.description: The state of one subject: their objects of the declared types, each as a `display` read serves it.
StateView.title: StateView

Suppression.description:
One entry of the suppression list: `key` is the subject's handle keyed with the reading source's salt
(the suppression-list spec); `removed` takes the entry `id` out of the reader's copy. The reason stays
with the producer: a vendor learns that it may not contact, never why.
Suppression.title: Suppression

SuppressionAddedDetail.description:
The subject may not be contacted for `purpose`, on `channel` or on every channel. `until` defaults to
the reason's own interval, or to no end.
SuppressionAddedDetail.title: SuppressionAddedDetail

SuppressionLiftedDetail.description: Lifts what the same source suppressed for `purpose` and `channel`.
SuppressionLiftedDetail.title: SuppressionLiftedDetail

SuppressionPage.description:
A page of changes, oldest first. With `reset`, the reader drops its copy before applying `items`:
the salt changed, or the cursor is older than what the list keeps.
SuppressionPage.title: SuppressionPage

due_at.description: Computed now from the rule and the values.
due_at.title: Due At

name.description: The agent's name inside the source, e.g. `closing`.
name.title: Name

parent_turn_id.description: The turn that opened this one as a sub-turn (a sub-agent, an agent as tool).
parent_turn_id.title: Parent Turn Id

TurnBlob.description:
A large value of the record. `sha256` is over its normalized canonical JSON (RFC 8785): the same value
always has the same hash.

content.description: The value itself, only in `stored` mode.
content.title: Content

pointer.description: Where the customer keeps it, in `pointer` mode.
pointer.title: Pointer

TurnBlob.title: TurnBlob

adapter.description: The framework adapter and its version, if any.
adapter.title: Adapter

TurnCall.description: One tool or model call of the turn, copied deep at the moment it happened.

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

name.description: The tool's name, or the model's for a model call.
name.title: Name

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_model.description: The result as the model saw it.
result_model.title: Result Model

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_ui.description: The result as the interface got it.
result_ui.title: Result Ui

TurnCall.title: TurnCall

compiler.description: The context compiler's version, from the pack.
compiler.title: Compiler

pack_hash.description: The hash of the pack this turn read.
pack_hash.title: Pack Hash

TurnConstraints.description: What the SDK measured of the constraints block on one tool call: sent, checked, violated.

constraints.description: The version of the constraints block applied.
constraints.title: Constraints

TurnConstraints.title: TurnConstraints

TurnObservation.description: State a tool result showed, with provenance per field; without provenance it is display only.
TurnObservation.title: TurnObservation

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

document.description: A document the turn wrote, by its blob.
document.title: Document

event_keys.description: The events `track()` sent for what the turn said: the text is never repeated here.
event_keys.title: Event Keys

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

TurnPins.description:
What must be the same for a replay to reproduce this turn. The recording document says which are
required; a turn without one of them is kept, marked not replayable.

assembler.description: The version of the company's context assembler.
assembler.title: Assembler

corpus_digest.description: Digest of the files the agent consults, computed in the SDK; never the files.
corpus_digest.title: Corpus Digest

model.description: The exact model the agent called.
model.title: Model

tool_schemas.description: Tool name -> hash of its schema.
tool_schemas.title: Tool Schemas

TurnPins.title: TurnPins

TurnRead.description: A read the turn made from Niadra, by its version: the pack by ETag, a block by its version.

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

blob.description: The content read, when the recording keeps it.
blob.title: Blob

TurnRead.title: TurnRead

TurnRecord.description:
One turn, from its input (a message, an interface action, an event, a timer firing) to the last thing
it emitted to the customer or to a document.

propertyNames.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

TurnRecord.title: TurnRecord

TurnSearchRequest.description: A search over the kept tier. The conversation id travels in the body, never in the URL.
TurnSearchRequest.title: TurnSearchRequest

TurnView.description: A recorded turn as the viewer shows it. In `pointer` and `hash_only` modes, blobs have no content.

replayable.description: Every pin the recording requires is there.
replayable.title: Replayable

TurnView.title: TurnView

TurnsResponse.description: 200 when every turn was taken, 207 with one error per rejected turn (by index).

duplicates.description: Turns already recorded: the same turn sent twice is one.
duplicates.title: Duplicates

TurnsResponse.title: TurnsResponse

ValueEvidence.description: A value in the turn record, from a tool's result or from state, that the number is checked against.

fresh_for.description: The value is within its type's `claim_max_age`, or the claim is `stale`.
fresh_for.title: Fresh For

gap_terms.description: The words that state each declared gap; a gap without them is stated by its name.
gap_terms.title: Gap Terms

must_state_gaps.description: The value's declared gaps must be said with it, or `gap_not_stated`.
must_state_gaps.title: Must State Gaps

same_role.description: The value's role is the number's role.
same_role.title: Same Role

value.description: A field or a computed value of `type`.
value.title: Value

ValueEvidence.title: ValueEvidence

ValueState.description: A value the company computed, kept as a versioned fact with the rule that produced it.

absent_as.description: The name of the absence, when absent.
absent_as.title: Absent As

ValueState.title: ValueState

Verification.description: Session verification levels. `no_customer` sits outside the V0-V4 scale.
Verification.title: Verification

Watch.description: An explicit "let me know when": the only way an interest raises a notice.

condition.description: A `niadra-expr` expression over the object's fields.
condition.title: Condition

Watch.title: Watch
